title: Booking a clinic appointment
summary: Pick a day and time, handle a fully booked slot, give your details and confirm.

hello.speaker: Receptionist
hello.zh: 您好，请问有什么可以帮您？
hello.pinyin: Nín hǎo, qǐngwèn yǒu shénme kěyǐ bāng nín?
hello.en: Hello, how can I help you?

rephrase.en: What do you need help with?

choices.en: I'd like to book an appointment with a doctor
Can I still be seen today?

when.speaker: Receptionist
when.pinyin: Hǎo de. Nǐ xiǎng yuē jǐ diǎn?
when.en: Okay. What time would you like?

rephrase.zh: 您想哪一天、什么时间来？
rephrase.pinyin: Nín xiǎng nǎ yì tiān, shénme shíjiān lái?
rephrase.en: Which day and what time would you like to come?

morning-full.speaker: Receptionist
morning-full.zh: 不好意思，明天上午已经约满了。下午两点可以吗？
morning-full.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, míngtiān shàngwǔ yǐjīng yuē mǎn le. Xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn kěyǐ ma?
morning-full.en: Sorry, tomorrow morning is fully booked. Would 2 p.m. work?

variants.en: There's nothing left in the morning.

rephrase.zh: 明天上午的号都没有了，只有下午两点还有空。
rephrase.pinyin: Míngtiān shàngwǔ de hào dōu méiyǒu le, zhǐyǒu xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn hái yǒu kòng.
rephrase.en: Tomorrow morning is all gone; only 2 p.m. is still free.

choices.zh: 如果有人取消，可以告诉我吗？
choices.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu rén qǔxiāo, kěyǐ gàosu wǒ ma?
choices.en: If someone cancels, could you let me know?

day-after.speaker: Receptionist
day-after.pinyin: Hòutiān shàngwǔ shí diǎn yǒu kòng.
day-after.en: The day after tomorrow, 10 a.m. is free.

choices.pinyin: Nà háishi míngtiān liǎng diǎn ba.
choices.en: Then tomorrow at two after all

waitlist.speaker: Receptionist
waitlist.zh: 可以，我把您放在候补名单上，有空位给您打电话。
waitlist.pinyin: Kěyǐ, wǒ bǎ nín fàng zài hòubǔ míngdān shang, yǒu kòngwèi gěi nín dǎ diànhuà.
waitlist.en: Sure. I'll put you on the waiting list and call you if a slot opens.

choices.pinyin: Hǎo de, nà xiān bāng wǒ yuē liǎng diǎn.
choices.en: Okay — book me in for two for now

choices.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ děng nín diànhuà.
choices.en: Okay, I'll wait for your call

after-three.speaker: Receptionist
after-three.zh: 三点以后……四点半可以吗？
after-three.pinyin: Sān diǎn yǐhòu... sì diǎn bàn kěyǐ ma?

late-slot.speaker: Receptionist
late-slot.pinyin: Zuì wǎn shì wǔ diǎn bàn.

choices.pinyin: Nà háishi sì diǎn bàn ba.

slots.speaker: Receptionist
slots.zh: 明天有下午两点和四点半，后天上午十点也有。
slots.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn hé sì diǎn bàn, hòutiān shàngwǔ shí diǎn yě yǒu.
slots.en: Tomorrow there's 2 p.m. and 4:30; the day after, there's also 10 a.m.

rephrase.zh: 可以约的时间有三个：明天两点、明天四点半、后天十点。
rephrase.pinyin: Kěyǐ yuē de shíjiān yǒu sān ge: míngtiān liǎng diǎn, míngtiān sì diǎn bàn, hòutiān shí diǎn.
rephrase.en: There are three times: tomorrow at 2, tomorrow at 4:30, and the day after at 10.

choices.pinyin: Zhèxiē shíjiān wǒ dōu bù xíng.
choices.en: None of those work for me

details.speaker: Receptionist
details.zh: 好的。请问您贵姓？电话号码是多少？
details.pinyin: Hǎo de. Qǐngwèn nín guìxìng? Diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
details.en: Okay. May I have your surname and phone number?

rephrase.zh: 我需要您的名字和手机号。
rephrase.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào nín de míngzi hé shǒujīhào.
rephrase.en: I need your name and mobile number.

choices.zh: 我姓李，电话是一三八，一二三四，五六七八。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xìng Lǐ, diànhuà shì yāo sān bā, yāo èr sān sì, wǔ liù qī bā.
choices.en: My surname is Li; my phone is 138 1234 5678

choices.zh: 我没有中国的手机号，可以留邮箱吗？
choices.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu Zhōngguó de shǒujīhào, kěyǐ liú yóuxiāng ma?
choices.en: I don't have a Chinese phone number — can I leave an email?
Do I need to bring anything?

email.speaker: Receptionist
email.zh: 可以，请把邮箱写在这里。
email.pinyin: Kěyǐ, qǐng bǎ yóuxiāng xiě zài zhèlǐ.
email.en: Sure, please write your email here.

bring.speaker: Receptionist
bring.zh: 请带上护照或者身份证。
bring.pinyin: Qǐng dài shàng hùzhào huòzhě shēnfènzhèng.
bring.en: Please bring your passport or ID card.

confirm.speaker: Receptionist
confirm.zh: 好，给您约好了。到时候请提前十分钟到。
confirm.pinyin: Hǎo, gěi nín yuē hǎo le. Dào shíhou qǐng tíqián shí fēnzhōng dào.
confirm.en: All booked. Please arrive ten minutes early.

rephrase.zh: 预约好了，请早来十分钟。
rephrase.pinyin: Yùyuē hǎo le, qǐng zǎo lái shí fēnzhōng.
rephrase.en: You're booked — please come ten minutes early.

choices.pinyin: Néng zài quèrèn yíxià shíjiān ma?
choices.en: Could you confirm the time again?

choices.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ wǎn dào zěnme bàn?

today.speaker: Receptionist
today.zh: 今天已经满了，最早是明天。要帮您约吗？
today.pinyin: Jīntiān yǐjīng mǎn le, zuì zǎo shì míngtiān. Yào bāng nín yuē ma?
today.en: Today is full; the earliest is tomorrow. Shall I book you in?

choices.zh: 我很不舒服，能不能早一点？
choices.pinyin: Wǒ hěn bù shūfu, néng bu néng zǎo yìdiǎn?
choices.en: I feel quite unwell — could it be sooner?

urgent.speaker: Receptionist
urgent.zh: 如果很急，可以去旁边的医院看急诊。
urgent.pinyin: Rúguǒ hěn jí, kěyǐ qù pángbiān de yīyuàn kàn jízhěn.
urgent.en: If it's urgent, you can go to the emergency department at the hospital next door.

choices.en: Okay, I'll go to emergency. Thanks

choices.pinyin: Bú yòng le, háishi yuē míngtiān ba.

price.speaker: Receptionist
price.zh: 初诊两百块，以后复诊一百。
price.pinyin: Chūzhěn liǎng bǎi kuài, yǐhòu fùzhěn yìbǎi.
price.en: A first visit is 200 yuan; follow-up visits are 100.

choices.en: Okay, I'd like to book, then

insurance.speaker: Receptionist
insurance.zh: 我们可以开发票，您自己找保险公司报销。
insurance.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ kāi fāpiào, nín zìjǐ zhǎo bǎoxiǎn gōngsī bàoxiāo.
insurance.en: We can issue a receipt; you claim it back from your insurer yourself.

choices.pinyin: Míngbai le, nà bāng wǒ yùyuē ba.
choices.en: I see — please book me in, then

reconfirm-end.speaker: Receptionist
reconfirm-end.zh: 我会给您发短信，确认时间和地址。
reconfirm-end.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nín fā duǎnxìn, quèrèn shíjiān hé dìzhǐ.
reconfirm-end.en: I'll text you to confirm the time and address.
reconfirm-end.outcome: Booked — a confirmation text is on its way.

late-end.speaker: Receptionist
late-end.zh: 晚到十五分钟以上，可能要重新约。
late-end.pinyin: Wǎn dào shíwǔ fēnzhōng yǐshàng, kěnéng yào chóngxīn yuē.
late-end.en: If you're more than fifteen minutes late, you may need to rebook.
late-end.outcome: Booked — and you know the lateness rule.

waitlist-end.speaker: Receptionist
waitlist-end.zh: 好的，有消息马上通知您。
waitlist-end.pinyin: Hǎo de, yǒu xiāoxi mǎshàng tōngzhī nín.
waitlist-end.en: Okay, I'll let you know as soon as something opens.
waitlist-end.outcome: You are on the waiting list.

er-end.speaker: Receptionist
er-end.zh: 好，出门右转就是医院。早日康复！
er-end.pinyin: Hǎo, chūmén yòu zhuǎn jiù shì yīyuàn. Zǎorì kāngfù!
er-end.en: Okay — turn right out of the door for the hospital. Get well soon!
er-end.outcome: You head to the emergency department.
